notes.bangladeshAdm3: geoBoundaries BGD-ADM3 (BBS/OCHA 2020) has 544 polygons, including metropolitan thanas. It is not the official 495-upazila list. Counts differ by definition and date.
notes.displaySimplification: ADM3 geometry simplified with Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.0012 deg (~130 m). ADM0-2 rounded to 5 decimals only. None of these files is cadastral.
notes.bilingualNames: Bangla names from Open Admin Data (CC BY 4.0), attached only after spatial/name checks. Unmatched units remain English-only.
notes.barind: Operational Barind pilot = the 8 Rajshahi Division districts listed. The physiographic Barind Tract (~7,770-10,000 km2) extends into Dinajpur/Rangpur and excludes floodplain parts; this is an administrative proxy, not a soil boundary.
notes.coastal: Coastal pilot = the 19 WARPO/World Bank coastal districts. Salinity is not uniform across them and requires dated local evidence.
notes.countryCodes: Country codes use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 where Natural Earth supplies one (ISO_A2_EH preferred for France, Norway, Kosovo and Taiwan). Somaliland, Northern Cyprus, Kashmir, Ashmore and Cartier, and Indian Ocean areas have no ISO alpha-2 code, so their Natural Earth ADM0_A3 code is retained (SOL, CYN, KAS, ATC, IOA).
